turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
I didn't come here to be complimented. What do you actually have on Owen's essay?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
I'm not in your position, I'm in my son's. You say you're following evidence, so put it on the table.
